mapper.sql: ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id, novel_id FROM user_collection UNION SELECT DISTINCT user_id, novel_id FROM user_finished_novel UNION SELECT DISTINCT user_id, novel_id FROM user_comment UNION SELECT DISTINCT user_id, novel_id FROM user_reading_history )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) FROM t WHERE t.novel_id = #{novelId}

SELECT other.novel_id AS novelId, COUNT(DISTINCT other.user_id) AS coCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM x WHERE x.novel_id = #{seedNovelId}) AS cntI, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM y WHERE y.novel_id = other.novel_id) AS cntJ FROM seed JOIN other ON seed.user_id = other.user_id WHERE seed.novel_id = #{seedNovelId} AND other.novel_id <> #{seedNovelId} GROUP BY other.novel_id ORDER BY coCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.novel_id AS novelId, COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS cnt FROM
t GROUP BY t.novel_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
